WITH standings_with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS average_wins
  FROM standings_with_previous
  GROUP BY country
),
all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average
  FROM country_averages
),
above_all AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, am.mean_average,
         ca.average_wins - am.mean_average AS excess_all
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
  WHERE ca.average_wins > am.mean_average
),
above_group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average
  FROM above_all
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT ag.average_wins, ag.excess_all,
         ag.average_wins - gm.mean_average AS excess_group
  FROM above_all AS ag
  CROSS JOIN above_group_mean AS gm
  WHERE ag.average_wins > gm.mean_average
)
SELECT
  AVG(average_wins) AS mean_final_average_wins,
  AVG(excess_all) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean,
  AVG(excess_group) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean
FROM final_countries;
